scope: Independent native-resolution static review of three intact retained no-shorts source poses after colour-only finishing. No source edits, generation, registry/public changes or counters by this reviewer. This is not final release acceptance.

canonicalIdentityAndQuality.evidence: All three native framed poses retain the recognizable bald faceless white-grey anatomy model, smooth neutral pelvis, no garments, white trainers and detailed neutral anatomical shading. Hinge, drive and extended-hip float retain coherent adult proportions. No replacement seams or new body construction are visible.

muscleRoleHierarchy.evidence: Primary is visibly stronger than secondary in all three poses. Role boundaries follow the existing muscle fields; near/far thigh fields and trunk panels remain anatomically readable without new ragged threshold strips.

fineContoursAndNoAddedGradient.evidence: Native visual review shows flat field interiors with fine grey source-derived muscle contours. finish.py uses solid palette RGB with source chroma-derived alpha and median-derived original contour detail; it creates no new spatial gradient. Small pale source edge/highlight transitions remain inherited.

neutralBodyAndEquipmentPreservation.evidence: Independent pixel comparison finds zero changed RGBA pixels outside the original primary/secondary colour-layer alpha domains for each pose. Head, arms, trainers, floor and neutral ordinary kettlebell remain visually intact. This is preservation evidence, not a substitute for contact/mechanics review.

staticSupportAndOcclusion.evidence: Both shoe soles rest on the original shared floor in the three native images without visible significant static support drift. Float and Drive retain overlapping two-hand handle grips. In Hike, forearms and handle continue behind the near thigh, and the bell remains opaque behind the legs; no grafted hand or invented skin was introduced. The occluded Hike hand contact cannot independently prove both grips from this frame alone.

threePhysicalStatesAndHonestReuse.evidence: Hike is the loaded backswing, Drive is the intermediate hip-extension state, and Float is chest-height with hips extended and arms long. Six distinct paths decode exactly to [2,3,1,1,3,2]; duplicates are honestly separate beats, not claimed extra physical poses. Dynamic loop continuity is still pending playback.

hikeUnclassifiedStrongPixels.finding: Native original/framed visual inspection places these pixels on the inherited bell body/one-ring handle metallic highlights behind the near thigh. They are outside the human muscle fields. Leaving these ordinary gear highlights unchanged is consistent with equipment preservation; they are not omitted purple muscle pixels.
